summary: Full e2e testing of PGSaathi MVP - backend APIs and frontend UI flows. All core features working. 25/26 backend tests passed. All frontend pages load and are functional.

minor.issue: FastAPI returns 403 instead of 401 for missing auth token. Expected 401 (unauthenticated) but gets 403 (forbidden). Minor semantic issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Check-In Date field uses browser native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy format) instead of ShadCN calendar component

issues: Quick Actions widget items (Add Tenant, Generate Invoice, View Complaints, Manage Properties) are not translated when Hindi language is selected - remain in English
Bar chart X-axis only shows labels for months with data; empty months have no labels, making the 6-month range unclear

action_items: LOW: Replace native date picker in Add Tenant form with ShadCN calendar component for consistent UX
LOW: Add Hindi translations for Quick Actions widget keys on Dashboard
LOW: Consider adding X-axis labels for all 6 months in Reports chart even if data is zero
critical_code_review_comments: Tenant email uniqueness: backend allows multiple tenants with same email (no unique constraint on tenant email) - may cause confusion
PropertyCreate model enforces gender_type as Literal['boys','girls','co-living'] but backend error message may be confusing to frontend developers if wrong value sent
PaymentCreate uses field name 'payment_mode' but the rent page UI might use 'payment_method' - should verify frontend sends correct field name
MessConfigCreate requires 'monthly_amount', 'meal_types', 'veg_nonveg', 'tracking_mode' (Literal['fixed','attendance']) - ensure frontend form sends all required fields with correct values

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all pages load, all core flows working)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 test properties (TEST_Property Alpha), 3 test tenants (TEST_Tenant Raj), 3 invoices, 2 payments, 2 complaints, 1 mess config during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. Login with TEST_owner2@pgsaathi.com / Test@1234. Language selector appears on first visit (no localStorage). Language toggle in navbar shows alternate language name (e.g., 'हिंदी' when in English). Property detail page shows floor hierarchy with Add Floor/Add Room buttons. All CRUD operations verified via backend tests.
rca_of_issues: Quick Actions not translated: likely missing translation keys for 'Add Tenant', 'Generate Invoice', 'View Complaints', 'Manage Properties' in /frontend/src/translations.js. Native date picker: Tenants.jsx form uses <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component.
